description: 6 packages (hummbl-axis, hummbl-contracts, hummbl-intel, hummbl-lattice, hummbl-lint-config, idp-spec) are missing from the publish-pypi.yml tag filters. Tags pushed for these packages will silently fail to publish to PyPI.
recommended_action: Add the missing package tag regexes to the push.tags list in .github/workflows/publish-pypi.yml.

description: check_license_consistency.py explicitly hardcodes 6 packages to bypass license validation (hummbl-bus, hummbl-compass, etc.), shipping software with missing or mismatched licenses while pretending CI is enforcing it.
recommended_action: Fix the missing LICENSE files in the 6 excluded packages and remove the known_issues bypass array from the check script.

description: MONOREPO-DESIGN.md Phase 1 claims 6 packages (hummbl-bus, hummbl-cognition, base120, etc.) are unmigrated with unchecked boxes, but they are fully populated in packages/python/ with passing tests.
recommended_action: Reconcile MONOREPO-DESIGN.md with the actual state of the repository to prevent ghost migrations.

description: hummbl-governance is being tested twice on Python 3.13 concurrently (once in the generic test matrix, once in test-hummbl-governance matrix).
recommended_action: Exclude hummbl-governance from the generic test matrix to save CI compute.
